name: weather-forecast
description: Weather forecast with optional atmospheric backgrounds.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
// shadcn-vue currently maps the navigation arrows across icon libraries, but
// its public icon index has no CloudSun, Waves, Wind, CloudRain or Snowflake
// entries. Keep those semantic forecast glyphs through an npm alias instead
// of silently substituting unrelated mapped icons.
import { ArrowDownIcon, ArrowUpIcon } from '@lucide/vue';
import { CloudRainIcon, CloudSunIcon, MoonIcon, SnowflakeIcon, SunIcon, WavesIcon, WindIcon } from 'wxcn-lucide';
export type IconName = 'arrowUp' | 'arrowDown' | 'weather' | 'sun' | 'moon' | 'tide' | 'wind' | 'rain' | 'snow';
export type IconSet = 'lucide' | 'tabler' | 'phosphor' | 'hugeicons' | 'remixicon';
withDefaults(defineProps<{ name: IconName; iconSet?: IconSet; class?: string }>(), {
 class: 'size-5'
});
</script>
<template>
 <ArrowUpIcon v-if="name === 'arrowUp'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <ArrowDownIcon v-else-if="name === 'arrowDown'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <CloudSunIcon v-else-if="name === 'weather'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <SunIcon v-else-if="name === 'sun'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <MoonIcon v-else-if="name === 'moon'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <WavesIcon v-else-if="name === 'tide'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <WindIcon v-else-if="name === 'wind'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <CloudRainIcon v-else-if="name === 'rain'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
 <SnowflakeIcon v-else-if="name === 'snow'" :class="$props.class" aria-hidden="true" />
</template>
